visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a bright classroom setting. A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a cream-colored off-shoulder blouse, stands in the foreground smiling warmly. Behind her, five elementary school students in various school uniforms (green, navy, and white) are positioned against a green chalkboard. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The woman brings a silver transverse flute to her lips and begins to play. She is the central focus, framed in a medium close-up. The students behind her listen attentively, with one girl in a green polo shirt raising her hand eagerly as she recognizes the tune. (3) The woman stops playing, lowers the flute, and speaks to the camera while gesturing with her hands. The students are smiling and looking towards her. (4) She resumes playing the flute for a second song. Colorful, cartoonish musical note graphics appear around her head. One student in the background points a finger to her head as if thinking. (5) In a series of quick cuts, the woman continues to play different snippets of music on the flute. Students react with raised hands and smiles. Text overlays frequently change at the top and bottom of the frame to mark the song numbers and titles. (6) The video concludes with the woman clapping her hands and laughing. She turns slightly to interact with the children behind her, who are also laughing and cheering. The shot remains at eye-level throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice speaking in Mandarin. A light, upbeat pop BGM with a steady electronic beat plays at a low volume in the background. (2) A transition occurs as the voice stops and a live flute solo begins. The flute has a bright, airy timbre and plays a recognizable pop melody. The room's natural acoustics provide a slight reverb. (3) A sharp "Ding" sound effect triggers a new phase, followed by more energetic female narration and a faint, higher-pitched child's voice answering a question. (4) Another flute snippet starts, playing a different melody. The tempo is slightly faster. (5) A series of rapid flute phrases interleaved with short vocal interjections and "Ding" sounds follow. The BGM remains consistent underneath. (6) The final phase features rhythmic clapping from multiple people, loud shared laughter (higher arousal), and the woman's final spoken outro with a friendly, inviting tone.
